# Generated by scripts/gen-cli-docs.sh from 'lazysubmodules tui -h'; do not edit.

Usage: lazysubmodules tui

Start the terminal user interface. Standard input and output must be a
terminal that supports cursor movement (TERM set and not "dumb").
Git runs without the terminal there, so fetching cannot answer prompts: it
needs a credential helper or an SSH agent, and SSH host keys that are
already known.
